title: Patent Agent - Biomedical, Bioengineering, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology

cond_0001.intro: [Company name masked] is a focused and agile patent law firm that bends over backwards to generate patent value for our clients. We're a technology-augmented prosecution and strategy firm at our core, and we partner with world-class monetization and litigation counsel on a mission-by-mission basis. The firm seeks an experienced Patent Agent to make an immediate impact with a high-growth biosystems client and to support our interdisciplinary team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Master our clients' products, services, and patents
Lead invention disclosure meetings and recommend filing strategies aligned with the client's strategic goals
Draft and prosecute utility patent applications primarily in relation to bioengineering technologies and also supporting our interdisciplinary team
Prepare periodic portfolio overviews and docket reports our clients
Instruct foreign associates and other law firms on prosecution tasks
Formulate international patent strategies
Counsel clients on portfolio and prosecution strategy
Support marketing efforts, including pitches and client visits
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
USPTO Registration Number
Degree(s) in biomedical engineering, bioengineering, cell biology, molecular biology, microbiology, or similar
At least 5 years of experience as a patent agent in a law firm, in-house, or technology transfer role (at least 50 patent applications drafted)
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Bayh Dole Act disclosure, election, and filing requirements
A desire to develop your abilities through diverse responsibilities, mentorship, and technology
Openness to utilizing patent prosecution and portfolio management technologies to write better patent applications and make better decisions
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The firm seeks an experienced Patent Agent to make an immediate impact with a high-growth biosystems client and to support our interdisciplinary team. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with patent prosecution and portfolio strategy.
cond_0410.responsibilities:
Master our clients' products, services, and patents
Lead invention disclosure meetings and recommend filing strategies aligned with the client's strategic goals
Draft and prosecute utility patent applications primarily in relation to bioengineering technologies and also supporting our interdisciplinary team
Prepare periodic portfolio overviews and docket reports our clients
Instruct foreign associates and other law firms on prosecution tasks
Formulate international patent strategies
Counsel clients on portfolio and prosecution strategy
Support marketing efforts, including pitches and client visits
cond_0410.requirements:
USPTO Registration Number
Degree(s) in biomedical engineering, bioengineering, cell biology, molecular biology, microbiology, or similar
At least 5 years of experience as a patent agent in a law firm, in-house, or technology transfer role (at least 50 patent applications drafted)
Familiarity with Bayh Dole Act disclosure, election, and filing requirements
A desire to develop your abilities through diverse responsibilities, mentorship, and technology
Openness to utilizing patent prosecution and portfolio management technologies to write better patent applications and make better decisions
cond_0410.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0410.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
